Name: CS_KEY_ASSIGN_MENUITEM_PARAM
Description: Determines the parameters relating the display of key assignments.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Name of the entry, from Menu Text (the action name, or the category name when Key is -1). 0: the entry is left out of both key configuration lists (it can still appear in the controls overview).

Fields.Name: Action (Key)
Fields.Description: The game action this entry rebinds: a KeyAssignParam row ID (its default bindings). -1: the entry is a category heading.

Fields.Name: Allow Unassign
Fields.Description: The binding can be cleared in the key configuration. Off: the clear command is refused.

Fields.Name: Allow Pad Rebinding
Fields.Description: The controller binding can be changed. Off: the entry is shown locked in the pad list and can't be cleared.

Fields.Name: Allow Mouse Rebinding
Fields.Description: The mouse binding can be changed. Off: the mouse column is shown locked and can't be cleared. The keyboard column is always changeable.

Fields.Name: Conflict Group
Fields.Description: Entries only conflict with entries of the same group: two of them on the same input are marked as a conflict. Group 2 conflicts with every group. Groups 1 and 2 are also checked against the fixed menu keys (KeyAssignParam_TypeA rows 26-53) when rebound on the keyboard.

Fields.Name: Controls Overview Text ID
Fields.Description: Name of the action in the controls overview, from Menu Text, shown next to the button it's bound to; several actions on one button are joined with "/". 0 or below: not shown in the overview.

Fields.Name: Show in Pad List
Fields.Description: The entry is shown in the controller key configuration list.

Fields.Name: Show in Keyboard/Mouse List
Fields.Description: The entry is shown in the keyboard and mouse key configuration list.
